# Yaxa

> The Intuitive Svelte UI Library — Nuxt UI v4 equivalent for SvelteKit 2.7+ & Svelte 5 with automated SEO, dynamic OpenGraph cards, sitemaps, robots.txt, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Quick Links

- [Documentation](https://yaxa.vercel.app/docs/intro): Full guides and API references.
- [AI Coding Agent Skill](https://yaxa.vercel.app/skills.md): Full markdown instructions and rules for AI coding assistants.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/FuntionalFrost/yaxa): Open-source source code and issues.
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/yaxa-svelte): Official npm package registry.

## Core Concepts & Architecture

- **Svelte 5 Runes**: Built exclusively with `$state`, `$derived`, `$props`, and `$bindable` — zero Virtual DOM overhead.
- **Tailwind CSS v4 Native Tokens**: Configured with `@theme` variables; fully customizable without legacy PostCSS.
- **Single Source of Truth (`src/site.config.ts`)**: Automated Schema.org JSON-LD, `/api/og` dynamic SVG OpenGraph images, environment-aware `robots.txt`, XML sitemaps with human-readable `sitemap.xsl` stylesheets, and PWA manifests.
- **Full-Stack SaaS Integrations**: Pre-integrated with Better-Auth, Drizzle ORM (Neon PostgreSQL & Turso LibSQL/SQLite), Polar.sh Merchant-of-Record payments, and Resend transactional emails.

- [SEO Suite - Robots & Sitemaps](https://yaxa.vercel.app/docs/seo-robots): Automated `robots.txt` and XML sitemaps with human-readable XSL.

## Installation & Quickstart

```bash
pnpm add yaxa-svelte @lucide/svelte
pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite @tailwindcss/typography
```

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { sveltekit } from '@sveltejs/kit/vite';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import { yaxa } from 'yaxa-svelte/vite';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [tailwindcss(), sveltekit(), yaxa()]
});
```

```svelte
<!-- src/routes/+layout.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import 'yaxa-svelte/yaxa.css';
  import { YaxaApp } from 'yaxa-svelte';
  import { siteConfig } from '../site.config';

  let { children } = $props();
</script>

<YaxaApp config={siteConfig}>
  {@render children()}
</YaxaApp>
```
